summary: Revised implementation plan for task-2: add focused Android instrumentation coverage in app/src/androidTest/.../ConnectingScreenTest.kt only, building on the existing task-1 test/production behavior. The tests will verify focus restoration after terminal Copy/Paste and IME context actions, preserve keyboardVisibleRequested semantics, and assert exact Ctrl-modified commitText byte routing without fixed sleeps.
assumptions: The intended editable scope is the task-1-touched instrumentation test file: app/src/androidTest/.../ConnectingScreenTest.kt, despite the prior allowed file scope being listed as the non-path value task-1.

Task-1 production behavior and helper seams are already present or available in the dirty worktree; task-2 should not add production code unless the current test file cannot compile against the existing seam.

Actual soft keyboard display can vary by device and IME, so tests will use bridge focus and keyboardVisibleRequested semantics as the stable contract rather than asserting physical keyboard visibility.
Existing dirty-worktree changes must be preserved and integrated with; no unrelated files or excluded paths will be read or modified.
pasteAsPlainText will be tested only when the runtime/API exposes and supports that action without making the rest of ConnectingScreenTest flaky.

tasks.title: Audit existing ConnectingScreenTest task-1 surface
tasks.description: Review only the relevant ConnectingScreenTest.kt sections around existing Ctrl/IME regression tests, terminal selection helpers, TerminalImeBridgeEditText discovery, TerminalView discovery, InputConnection helpers, keyboardVisibleRequested helpers, and ActionMode Copy/Paste helpers. Confirm existing raw virtual-key tests remain present or can be superseded by stronger exact-byte coverage without losing intent.
verification: Do not inspect excluded paths.
Confirm the task-1 focus/key-routing seams exist before adding new tests.
Confirm no unrelated dirty worktree changes are overwritten.

tasks.title: Add bounded focus and selection wait helpers
tasks.description: In ConnectingScreenTest.kt, add narrow test helpers to locate TerminalImeBridgeEditText and TerminalView, request/show the keyboard through existing UI paths, snapshot keyboardVisibleRequested, assert bridge focus, assert TerminalView focus during selection, wait for terminal selection to become inactive, and wait for the hidden bridge to regain focus. Use Compose waitUntil or equivalent state polling only.
verification: No Thread.sleep, SystemClock.sleep, or fixed timing delay is added for selection dismissal or focus restoration.
Timeout failures include clear assertion messages for selection still active and bridge focus not restored.
Helpers avoid new private reflection unless existing helpers already use it and no public/test seam exists.

tasks.title: Add terminal ActionMode Copy focus contract test
tasks.description: Add a separate test for terminal selection ActionMode Copy. It should request keyboard visibility, assert TerminalImeBridgeEditText focus, start terminal selection, assert TerminalView focus, invoke Copy immediately, wait until selection is inactive, wait until the hidden bridge regains focus, assert keyboardVisibleRequested is unchanged, clear setup bytes, then tap compact Ctrl and use InputConnection.commitText("a", 1) twice to assert ordered bytes [0x01, 0x61].
verification: Test name clearly distinguishes terminal ActionMode Copy from IME copy.
Exact-byte assertion is limited to the final Ctrl-A/plain-a payload.

tasks.title: Add terminal ActionMode Paste focus contract test
tasks.description: Add a separate test for terminal selection ActionMode Paste using a deterministic seeded clipboard. It should request keyboard visibility, assert bridge focus, start terminal selection, assert TerminalView focus, invoke Paste immediately, wait until selection is inactive, wait until bridge focus is restored, assert keyboardVisibleRequested is unchanged, clear paste/setup bytes, then verify compact Ctrl plus two commitText("a", 1) calls produce [0x01, 0x61].
verification: Clipboard is seeded deterministically before invoking Paste.
Bracketed paste or clipboard payload bytes are cleared before the final modifier assertion.

tasks.title: Add IME paste context-action tests
tasks.description: Add separate tests using the hidden bridge InputConnection.performContextMenuAction(android.R.id.paste) and, when supported on the runtime, android.R.id.pasteAsPlainText. These tests should exercise the IME editor context-action path rather than terminal ActionMode Paste, assert keyboardVisibleRequested is unchanged, and verify compact Ctrl plus committed A produces [0x01, 0x61].
verification: pasteAsPlainText is API/runtime conditional and does not skip or destabilize the full class.
IME paste tests remain separate from terminal ActionMode Paste.
Assertions do not depend on physical soft-keyboard display.

tasks.title: Add IME copy context-action test
tasks.description: Add a separate IME Copy test using stable InputConnection/editor APIs on the hidden bridge to create selectable shadow text, select a range, and invoke performContextMenuAction(android.R.id.copy). Then assert keyboardVisibleRequested is unchanged and verify compact Ctrl plus two commitText("a", 1) calls produce [0x01, 0x61].
verification: Use existing InputConnection/editor APIs only; avoid expanding private reflection.
Setup shadow-text commits do not pollute the final byte assertion.
Only assert the context-action handled result where stable across API levels.

tasks.title: Run focused connected instrumentation validation
tasks.description: Run the required focused connected Android instrumentation command and capture the exact result. If no emulator/device is available, report the exact Gradle/device failure without weakening or replacing the required verification.
verification: ./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest '-Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=com.majordaftapps.sshpeaches.app.session_ui.ConnectingScreenTest'
Search the changed test code to confirm no fixed sleeps were added for selection inactive or bridge focus restoration.

tasks.title: Report artifacts and residual risk
tasks.description: Return the implementation result with modified artifacts, exact commands run, exact test outcomes, any emulator/API limitations, task count, and review rounds. Confirm hidden-editor sentinel cleanup was not included unless it proved necessary and low risk.
verification: Final report mentions ConnectingScreenTest.kt changes.
Final report does not claim connected validation passed unless the required Gradle command completed successfully.

risks: Focus restoration after ActionMode teardown is asynchronous, so tests must use bounded state polling rather than fixed sleeps.
Physical soft keyboard visibility is device and IME dependent; bridge focus and keyboardVisibleRequested are the stable assertions.
pasteAsPlainText behavior varies by API level and InputConnection implementation, so that coverage must be conditional.
The IME copy shadow-text path may be brittle if the hidden bridge does not expose stable editable selection behavior; use existing editor APIs and avoid new reflection.
Dirty worktree changes may overlap in ConnectingScreenTest.kt and must be preserved while adding only task-2 test coverage.
